name: Customize motion, density and glass effects
description: Checks the new visual personalization controls change the library appearance and persist across reloads.
steps: Open Customize
Choose High-refresh smooth, Compact browsing and Strong glass
Close Customize and inspect the library
Reload and reopen Customize
expected: The selected motion, density and glass preferences remain selected and visibly affect controls/cards without overriding reduced-motion preferences or promising a hardware refresh rate.

name: Open VideoGram and browse available library links
covers: empty state when no stream URLs exist
description: Checks VideoGram is reachable from navigation and shows video-linked titles or a useful empty state.
steps: Tap VideoGram in the top navigation
If clips are listed, test native play controls and mute
Use Open series or return to Library
If no stream URLs exist, inspect the empty state
expected: VideoGram opens, lists available episode stream URLs with native video controls and series context, or clearly explains that links must be added; navigation back to the library works.

name: Drag and restore the AI assistant bubble
description: Checks the assistant can be dragged, stays within the viewport and opens when tapped without dragging.
steps: Drag the floating AI bubble to another visible corner
Release, then tap the bubble without moving it
Reload MaseTv
expected: The bubble stays at its saved position after reload, and a normal tap opens the assistant.

name: Choose independent AI chat themes
description: Checks new chat-board styles can be selected without changing the website palette.
steps: Open Customize
Choose Aurora, Ocean or Candy for the AI chat board
Open the AI assistant and choose another style from its palette menu
expected: The chosen chat-board style is applied independently of the website theme and remains selected after reload.

name: Enable seasonal website themes
description: Checks seasonal theme automation can be enabled or disabled from Customize.
steps: Open Customize
Enable automatic event themes
Disable automatic event themes
expected: The setting can be switched on and off, and seasonal themes only auto-apply while the setting is enabled.

name: Apply a local weather theme with consent
description: Checks local weather is requested only after a user action and a visible status is shown.
steps: Open Customize
Tap Use my local weather and grant location permission
If weather cannot load, retry or deny permission
expected: A weather palette is applied only after a successful weather lookup; permission denial or lookup failure shows a clear message.

name: AI applies requested event theme
description: Checks supported event-theme requests apply a matching palette and return an acknowledgement.
steps: Open MaseTv AI
Ask it to switch to a Christmas theme
Ask it to switch to a New Year theme
expected: Christmas applies the emerald palette and New Year applies the sunset palette, with a confirmation in chat.

name: Double-tap to customize the AI companion
description: Checks that the floating assistant opens its customization studio on a double tap and offers personal appearance controls.
steps: Double-tap the floating AI button
Choose a different avatar
Choose an animation and bubble shape
Reload the website
expected: The AI button studio opens, the selected avatar/animation/shape are applied, and preferences remain selected after reload.

name: Use pill-shaped navigation and homepage actions on mobile
description: Verifies the refreshed iOS-inspired pill controls remain usable on a narrow mobile viewport without replacing the separate AI companion button.
steps: Open MaseTv on a mobile viewport
Use Home, search and Customize controls
Open the homepage and activate a primary or secondary action
expected: Navigation and homepage actions appear as rounded pill controls, remain reachable without horizontal page overflow, and the AI companion retains its distinct floating orb design.

name: Join Channel stays floating and shrinks on scroll
description: Checks the Telegram channel join action remains reachable while scrolling and becomes a smaller pill after the page moves.
steps: Open MaseTv on mobile
Scroll down the homepage
Inspect the floating Join Channel pill and tap it
expected: The Join Channel action stays fixed near the bottom-left, shrinks to a compact pill while scrolling, and remains tappable without covering the page excessively.

name: Customize sheet scrolls on a phone and modes change layout
description: Verifies a long Customize panel can scroll independently on mobile and each experience mode applies a visible browsing layout.
steps: Open Customize on a mobile viewport
Scroll down through all website color and customization options
Select Samsung One UI, iPhone Liquid Glass, then Cinema Pro and return Home after each selection
expected: The Customize panel scrolls to its lower controls without trapping them off-screen, and the selected experience mode visibly changes the home layout while remaining selected after reload.

name: Switch experience modes and use smart library filters
covers: movie drama and My List filters
description: Checks the new experience modes change the app layout and that the library categories filter titles without relying on title-name keywords.
steps: Open Customize and choose Samsung One UI
Return Home and inspect MaseTv Brief and its quick actions
Choose Movies, Chinese Drama and My List filters
Choose iPhone Liquid Glass, open search, and search for an episode title or episode number
Reload MaseTv
expected: The selected experience mode remains active after reload, One UI shows the Brief dashboard, category filters show matching library items, and search can find episode metadata.
